about: Vectors for extensions/channel-agent/0.1 (DEC-0150), written by tools/vectors/channel-agent.ts, never by hand. `key`: the extension key. `declarations`: a document and the findings {code, instancePath} a checker reports on it, in the reference's order (a port may compare them as a set). `site` says where the key is read: `manifest` (kind manifest) under provider.extensions, at /provider/extensions/https:~1~1fabric.passioncode.ai~1agent-contract~1extensions~1channel-agent~10.1, or `well-known` (kind service-well-known, a service with no manifest) under extensions, at /extensions/https:~1~1fabric.passioncode.ai~1agent-contract~1extensions~1channel-agent~10.1 (CA-1). FAC-SEM-162, in a manifest only, at the key under /extensions or /capabilities/<i>/extensions, where a reader does not read it, each followed by the FAC-SEM-165 findings of that value where it stands; then FAC-SEM-165 at each member name and each string of the value shaped like a credential (at most 1 000 000 code points read in all for one document, every copy of the declaration in it sharing them, counted as the detector reads them, then one finding at the key that the rest was not read), by shape (FAC-SEM-101's detector on the first 4097 code points), a name at the object that holds it, a value under a name that is not plain (letters, digits, _ and -, at most 64, no run of 7 digits once - and _ are left out) at its nearest plain ancestor with every descendant, a member more than 64 levels down at its ancestor 64 levels down, at most 64 places and then one finding at the key counting the rest, the narrow readings only at their place and only for a value of their own grammar (a project's token slot segment by segment, its suite and outbox of the relativeRef grammar by the path-aware reading, secretArgument and secretUrl, and a queue's recommendation of the opaqueId grammar by a provider key's and a JWT's shapes only), anything else read whole, a place writing a declared name, an index of a declared array or *, a member whose name is not plain collapsing its place for itself and every descendant, before the schema check, in a valid or an invalid value (CA-5); then FAC-SEM-162 at the key for a value invalid against service-channel-agent-extension.schema.json, or with an array longer than its schema's maxItems, a map wider than its maxProperties, a closed object with more members than the schema declares, or a string or member name over 4096 code points (each checked before the schema, the limits read from the schema), which a reader treats as not declared, its message naming each failed keyword's place with the schema's own allowed values for required, enum, const and pattern and never a declared value (CA-2); for a valid value, per project in order, FAC-SEM-163 at a repeated project, category code, tier code, channel id, source id (a declined source counted with the sources), queue id or recorded decision id (the second occurrence), and at a channel's decision when replies are off and it is null or when it names a decision recorded_decisions does not list (CA-3); then FAC-SEM-164 at texts/holding when holding_reply is true and it is absent, at texts/final when replies_enabled is true and it is absent, at clarifying_question when true on a store_review, at a tier's label that is blank or carries U+2014, at a text that is blank (nothing left after white space, \p{Cf}, \p{Cc}, \p{Z}, \p{Default_Ignorable_Code_Point}, U+115F, U+1160, U+3164, U+FFA0, U+2800 and U+FFFC) or carries U+2014, a text's language written * when plain and placed at its texts/holding or texts/final map when not, at a queue's recommendation when answered_signal is none and it is absent, and once at evals/spend_record when a budget is above 0 and it is absent or null (CA-4). No message carries a declared value.
